_schema.backs: Appendix A.4 KL table (Table A.4-1) and the KL hierarchy reported in Section 5.1 / Figure 6
_schema.layout: {model: {L: [scramble_layer_ids], n_scr: int, n_pr: int, conds: {'<subspace>|<intervention>': [ per_prompt: [ per_scramble_kl ] ]}}}
_schema.units: nats; KL of the top-k next-token distribution, intervened vs unperturbed (field kl_divergence_topk in the source file)
_schema.prompt_set: SpecA, 40 prompts, single-pass intervention at the layer named in L
_schema.aggregation_convention: mean over a prompt's scrambles first, then mean over the 40 prompts within model, then an UNWEIGHTED mean across the 10 instruction-tuned models. SEM = population SD (ddof=0) / sqrt(10). No trimming, no median, no outlier filter. Verified 2026-08-03 against Group_D_Causal_Hierarchy_Report_v11_3.md Section 2.1 — all 14 rows reproduce exactly, means and SEMs.
_schema.n_scrambles: rotation and mix carry 3 scrambles per prompt; attenuate and transplant carry 1
_schema.paper_scope: The protocol has 14 conditions; Paper 1 reports 8. The six transplant conditions (F|transplant_within, F|transplant_cross, F|transplant_null, D|transplant, S|transplant, P|transplant) were removed from Paper 1 at v30 and are retained here only so this file reproduces the source report in full. Do not reintroduce them into Paper 1 tables, figures or condition counts.
